source: Fixed lattice,kappa>0,0<=R<9/64,m=kappa*(1/2-3R),real smooth local gauge-invariant norm(U)<=delta<=m/8; actual C2 tails and fixed marked orthonormal invariant Killing noise frames

construction.vector_space: B=C(X;ell2 link-frame coefficients),flat derivative in C(X;Hilbert-Schmidt matrices)
construction.traced_smoothing: Sum scalar reverse Poincare over output components: ||partial P_t^B F||_HS<=||F||/sqrt(2kappa*t),without volume factor
construction.frame_connection: C_a z=(1/2)e_a cross z; gen S=-A_B+J+Z_0,J_i=2kappa sum_a C_a X_ia F_i,Z_0_i=kappa*C(beta_i)-kappa*I
construction.force_regularization: G(Dpsi)=psi DU gives partial Dpsi in C(HS),bound D_*=H*(alpha L+M_U)/[2kappa*(1+x)]; covariant Dr in C(HS),bound B_*=H*D_*+L^2+L. Actual finite-source derivatives recover uniformly in the same HS topology
construction.same_leaf_before_Gronwall: Bounded coordinate distances and the factorial Volterra remainder first prove same-noise solution differences lie in ell2. Row/column bounds then permit the force Lipschitz Gronwall argument
construction.pathwise_uniqueness: Every initial configuration; same-noise leaf stability factor exp[kappa*(3R+2B_*)t],not Ricci contraction
construction.strong_realization: Compatible weak joint laws and pathwise uniqueness give adapted measurable marked-noise path maps for every initial distribution. No universal exceptional set for all uncountably many x or perfect flow claimed
construction.closed_obstruction_retained: Nonconstant-probe infinite-horizon density extension remains obstructed and is not used

Use paired solution/noise limits, cross brackets and pathwise uniqueness; marginal weak convergence alone does not establish it, and beta_j-beta is not generally globally ell2.
